message.text:
Derived memo metadata comes from rebuilding tags and properties from markdown. I need to locate the computation site, identify triggering operations, and list the extracted properties.

I will examine the MemoPayload proto, RebuildMemoPayload, ExtractAll, ExtractProperties, and their call sites to pinpoint the exact computation site, recomputation triggers, and extracted properties.
I'll trace memo payload derivation: where it runs, what triggers it, and what it extracts.
I need to check whether mention data is stored and locate the trigger sites for RebuildMemoPayload.

The computation site is `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll`. The actual extraction logic resides in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

RebuildMemoPayload writes Tags and Property onto Memo.Payload.

Triggers:
- CreateMemo always rebuilds before insert.
- UpdateMemo rebuilds when the update mask includes "content".
- memopayload.Runner.RunOnce performs a batch rebuild, though it is not wired at startup.
- CreateMemoComment routes through CreateMemo, so it also triggers recomputation.

Extracted properties stored on the payload:
- Tags from #tags.
- Property flags: has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks.
- Title from the first H1.

Mentions are extracted by ExtractAll but are not persisted on the payload; they are handled separately via memo_mention_helpers.
Persisted derived metadata includes tags and property. Mentions are extracted live for notifications and are not stored on the memo payload.

h14.
memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload (via markdown.Service.ExtractAll) — server/runner/memopayload/runner.go, internal/markdown/markdown.go; CreateMemo and UpdateMemo when content changes; tags plus Property (title, has_link, has_code, has_task_list, has_incomplete_tasks)

`RebuildMemoPayload` calls `ExtractAll` and writes `Memo.Payload.Tags` and `Memo.Payload.Property` (`proto/store/memo.proto`). `CreateMemo` always rebuilds before insert (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`); `UpdateMemo` rebuilds only when the update mask includes `content`. `CreateMemoComment` goes through `CreateMemo`, so it rebuilds too. `Runner.RunOnce` can rebuild every memo but is not started with the server. Location is user-set and left alone. `ExtractAll` also finds `@mentions`; those are not stored on the payload (used later for notifications in `memo_mention_helpers.go`).
